steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compute. Each measure is computed from the week's records by the published definition.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Week with missing records
findings.fix: Add the missing records and recompute

findings.title: Measure with no source records
findings.fix: Name the source of the measure

outcome.notChecked: Whether the metrics reflect real customer value.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

pros: Flags a measure with no source records, a failure with no restore time, and a week with missing records.
cons: Not checked: Whether the metrics reflect real customer value.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-devops-weekly-delivery-report skill on the records for this review.
